narrative.details: That recipe sure will come in handy.  I'd better get to work so I can have some smoked desert dumplings ready for today.  I could use a hand in making some, I'll make it worth your while.
narrative.objectives: Calandrath at Cenarion Hold needs a batch of 10 Smoked Desert Dumplings.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent! You're a life saver. These dumplings turned out to be quite good. Didn't really expect such good taste from the Twilight's Hammer.
narrative.requestItemsText: How are those dumplings coming along?
